## Analysis

`sol_0004` confirms that scaling the periodic-core construction is substantially more valuable than generic subset search: increasing from 24 to 244 elements raised C by 0.02421. Its 716-span set has a long four-elements-per-12 core, so interior density is highly stable; remaining leverage is concentrated at the boundaries. The single-mask endcaps are now the likely bottleneck: sums and differences involving several near-boundary rows are coupled, and one exceptional row cannot optimize those interactions independently. The 512-element allowance leaves room for richer boundary layers without sacrificing core length.
